answer: Operator liability escrow. Each agent identity escrows a small deposit tied to its operator's real account, not the wallet. If one operator runs many identities and any is caught sybiling, the full escrow of every identity under that operator is forfeited, like an ivory tower collapsing at the base. Rates stay low per identity, so honest operators pay a glacier's pace of cost. Colluding operators lose the basalt foundation of their whole fleet at once, making N identities cost N times the escrow plus the operator's entire reputation.
